【原视频简介】
Today I’m in Portland, Maine at Mister Bagel taking on their GIANT Breakfast Pizza Challenge! 🍕🥓🍳

Hungry challengers have just 30 minutes to finish a massive breakfast pizza loaded with ½ lb of garlic cream cheese, ½ lb of jalapeño cream cheese, ½ lb of cheese, 8 eggs, ½ lb of ham, 1 lb of bacon, and 1 lb of sausage, all piled on top of 1.5 lbs of dough!

Finish it in time and the pizza is FREE, plus you’ll earn a winner’s shirt and a spot on the Wall of Fame! 🏆

Can I conquer this massive breakfast pizza before the clock hits zero, or will I end up with egg on my face? 😅

A huge thank you to Jane and Joel for the amazing pizza, kindness, and hospitality!

🍕 Subscribe for weekly food challenges and restaurant adventures, and comment below what I should take on next!
